但是均会导致页面崩溃

其实崩溃了问题不大，主要是lobechat在崩溃的时候会丢数据，此类学术问题普遍较长，有很大概率会出现特殊标签


### 📷 复现步骤

随机

### 🚦 期望结果

1. 可以不渲染，但是别崩溃
2. 正确处理崩溃逻辑，不要让崩溃页面把模型最新轮的对话挤没了
3. 如[此issue](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5840)

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves the model outputting unexpected HTML tags (e.g., `math`), which causes the page to crash and lose data. This falls under "Incorrect model output handlers" in the LLM operation issues category, as it relates to managing unexpected model outputs.
